name: browser-undetected
description: Drive a real, undetected Chrome from the shell: human-like mouse and typing, a persistent session, and full network capture.

interface.longDescription: Pilot a real, undetected Chrome from the shell: navigate, click, type, fill forms, log in, scrape, screenshot, and capture every request, response and WebSocket frame. Human-like mouse curves and typing cadence, and the browser stays alive between commands so multi-step flows work across separate tool calls.
defaultPrompt: Use browser-undetected to open this site and tell me what is on it.
Capture the API calls this page makes while I browse it.
Log in to this site and keep the session for the next commands.
